note: An ordinary first message that names a place and a date range must not return HTTP 502 first_intake_reply_flagged. The Hilo line, a date range, a place-only line, and a party-size line each produce a stored app turn from vacation-app-reply-rules with a model stamp. A draft that invents a weekday or says someone already has access stays blocked. blockedReasons are server-side only.

assertions.note: Exact harness turn-1 line plus date-range, place-only, and party-size lines ship a stamped app turn. A seeded bad draft is still blocked. The client payload does not include blockedDraft or blockedReasons.
